cards.name: Omega, Heartless Evolution
lines: Wave Cannon — When ~ enters, for each opponent, tap up to one target nonland permanent that opponent controls. Put X stun counters on each of those permanents and you gain X life, where X is the number of nonbasic lands you control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No op taps each target chosen in a variable-count slot (tapAndGoadEachChosen also goads), so tapping up to one target nonland permanent per opponent with X stun counters cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Uthros Psionicist
lines: The second spell you cast each turn costs {2} less to cast.
cards.inexpressibleReason: costReduction has no restriction to the second spell cast each turn (the ordinal rule exists only for triggers), so 'the second spell you cast each turn costs {2} less' cannot be stated.

cards.name: Hotshot Mechanic
lines: ~ crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no static or rule modifier that changes the power a creature counts for crew (crewVehicle only sets the minimum power required of a crew cost), so "crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater" cannot be stated.

cards.name: Eerie Interference
lines: Prevent all damage that would be dealt to you and creatures you control this turn by creatures.
cards.inexpressibleReason: A damage shield covers either you or objects you control, not both in one effect, and the schema cannot restrict prevented damage to sources that are creatures.

cards.name: Niv-Mizzet, Dracogenius
lines: Whenever ~ deals damage to a player, you may draw a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The only damage-to-player trigger, dealsDamageToOpponent, fires only for opponents, but the line says 'a player', which includes Niv-Mizzet's own controller.

cards.name: Nezumi Linkbreaker
lines: When this creature dies, create a 1/1 red Mercenary creature token with "{T}: Target creature you control gets +1/+0 until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery."
cards.backTranslation: When this creature dies, create a 1/1 red Mercenary creature token with "{T}: Target creature you control gets +1/+0 until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery."

cards.name: Flux
lines: Each player discards any number of cards, then draws that many cards.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Each player discarding any number of chosen cards and then drawing that many has no schema form (discardEachPlayer takes a fixed count, and eachPlayerDiscardHandThenDraw discards the whole hand).

cards.name: Argothian Elder
lines: {T}: Untap two target lands.
cards.backTranslation: {T}: Untap target land and untap another target land. Activate at any time.

cards.name: Gimli's Axe
lines: As long as equipped creature is legendary, it has menace.
cards.backTranslation: Equipped creature that is legendary has menace.

cards.name: Network Terminal
lines: {1}, {T}, Tap another untapped artifact you control: Draw a card, then discard a card.
cards.backTranslation: {1}, {T}, Tap another artifact you control: Draw a card, then discard a card. Activate at any time.
differences: Text A's cost taps another untapped artifact you control; Text B says tap another artifact you control, dropping the requirement that the artifact be untapped.

cards.name: Bothersome Noisemaker
lines: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, amass Goblins 1.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, amass 1 with the Goblin subtype.

cards.name: Capital Punishment
lines: Council's dilemma — Starting with you, each player votes for death or taxes. Each opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice for each death vote and discards a card for each taxes vote.
cards.inexpressibleReason: councilVote applies one branch by majority, but this card applies its effect once per vote (a sacrifice for each death vote and a discard for each taxes vote), and no per-vote count form exists.

cards.name: Necrosynthesis
lines: When enchanted creature dies, look at the top X cards of your library, where X is its power. Put one of those cards into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
cards.inexpressibleReason: lookAtTopN takes a fixed count, not a value, so 'look at the top X cards of your library, where X is the enchanted creature's power' cannot be stated.

cards.name: Veteran Beastrider
lines: At the beginning of your end step, untap each creature you control.
cards.backTranslation: At the beginning of your end step, untap each creature you control.

cards.name: All of History, All at Once
lines: Time travel.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Time travel (adding or removing time counters on suspended cards and time-countered permanents) has no effect or condition in the schema.

cards.name: Rith's Grove
lines: When this land enters, sacrifice it unless you return a non-Lair land you control to its owner's hand.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No op offers the choice between returning a non-Lair land you control to hand and sacrificing this land instead (returnOneToHand is mandatory and there is no sacrifice-unless fallback).

cards.name: Haunt of the Dead Marshes
lines: {2}{B}: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Activate only if you control a legendary creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No graveyard-to-battlefield effect returns this card from its own graveyard tapped (returnDepartedSourceToBattlefield has no tapped option, and returnDiedSourceToBattlefield is for dying sources), so the activation cannot be exact.

cards.name: Goblin Assault
lines: Goblin creatures attack each combat if able.
cards.backTranslation: Each Goblin creature attacks each combat if able.

cards.name: Fishing Gear
lines: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, exile the top card of that player's library. If it's a permanent card, you may put it onto the battlefield under your control. If you don't, create a 1/1 blue Fish creature token.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Exiling the top card of the defending player's library with a put-onto-the-battlefield-or-create-a-Fish branch has no IR op: lookAtTopN only reads the controller's library and exileFaceDownPlayable exiles face down and is castOnly.

cards.name: Focus the Mind
lines: This spell costs {2} less to cast if you've cast another spell this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The cost reduction 'if you've cast another spell this turn' needs castSpellThisTurn to exclude the spell being cast, but the schema does not say whether that tally includes the spell at announcement, so the exact threshold cannot be stated.

cards.name: Calamity Bearer
lines: If a Giant source you control would deal damage to a permanent or player, it deals double that damage to that permanent or player instead.
cards.backTranslation: If a source you control with subtype Giant would deal damage, it deals double that damage instead.

cards.name: Long Road Home
lines: Exile target creature. At the beginning of the next end step, return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control with a +1/+1 counter on it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The delayed return of the exiled card has no field to put a +1/+1 counter on the card as it returns to the battlefield.

cards.name: Necrologia
lines: Cast this spell only during your end step.
cards.backTranslation: Cast this spell only during the end step of your turn.

cards.name: Ertai's Scorn
lines: This spell costs {U} less to cast if an opponent cast two or more spells this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The cost reduction condition is 'an opponent cast two or more spells this turn'; the schema's castSpellThisTurn counts only the controller's own casts, and no condition reads an opponent's cast tally.

cards.name: Elvish Pioneer
lines: When this creature enters, you may put a basic land card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
cards.inexpressibleReason: handToBattlefield has no tapped option, so "put a basic land card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped" cannot be stated exactly (the tapped form exists only for library searches).

cards.name: Aeve, Progenitor Ooze
lines: ~ isn't legendary if it's a token.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no continuous effect that removes the Legendary supertype from a token-only permanent (layer 4 has no removeSupertypes, and setSupertypes is not defined as removal), so 'isn't legendary if it's a token' cannot be modeled exactly.

cards.name: Circle of Flame
lines: Whenever a creature without flying attacks you or a planeswalker you control, this enchantment deals 1 damage to that creature.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever a creature without flying attacks, if the defending player is you, this deals 1 damage to that creature.

cards.name: Harper Recruiter
lines: Whenever this creature attacks, look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal a Cleric card, a Rogue card, a Warrior card, and/or a Wizard card from among them and put those cards into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The look-at-top-four pick takes one filter with one pick count, so 'up to one each of a Cleric, Rogue, Warrior and/or Wizard card' (a separate optional choice per type) cannot be said.

cards.name: Frenzied Goblin
lines: Whenever this creature attacks, you may pay {R}. If you do, target creature can't block this turn.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever this creature attacks, choose target creature. You may pay {R}. If you do, that creature can't block this turn.

cards.name: Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad
lines: Whenever Altaïr attacks, exile up to one target Assassin creature card from your graveyard with a memory counter on it. Then for each creature card you own in exile with a memory counter on it, create a tapped and attacking token that's a copy of it. Exile those tokens at end of combat.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no memory-counter state, so 'with a memory counter on it' cannot be selected, and the tapped-and-attacking copy tokens exiled at end of combat have no exact form (createTokenCopyOf has no attacking or end-of-combat exile option).

cards.name: Destined Confrontation
lines: Each player chooses any number of creatures they control with total power 4 or less, then sacrifices all other creatures they control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect lets each player choose creatures by total power 4 or less and sacrifice the rest.

cards.name: Hell's Caretaker
lines: {T}, Sacrifice a creature: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only during your upkeep.
cards.backTranslation: {T}, Sacrifice another creature you control (this creature may be sacrificed): Put target creature card from your graveyard onto the battlefield. Activate only during your upkeep.
differences: Text A lets the sacrificed creature be any creature you control, including this creature itself; Text B requires sacrificing another creature you control, so this creature cannot be the sacrifice (its parenthetical that this creature may be sacrificed contradicts the word 'another').

cards.name: Gollum, Scheming Guide
lines: Whenever ~ attacks, look at the top two cards of your library, put them back in any order, then choose land or nonland. An opponent guesses whether the top card of your library is the chosen kind. Reveal that card. If they guessed right, remove ~ from combat. Otherwise, you draw a card and ~ can't be blocked this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no effect where an opponent guesses whether the top library card is land or nonland, reveals it, and the guess then decides removal from combat or a draw with unblockability.

cards.name: Vampires' Vengeance
lines: ~ deals 2 damage to each non-Vampire creature. Create a Blood token.
cards.backTranslation:
This spell deals 2 damage to each creature that isn't a Vampire.
Create a Blood token, a colorless artifact token with the subtype Blood. It has "{1}, {T}, Discard a card, Sacrifice this artifact: Draw a card."

cards.name: Kaza, Roil Chaser
lines: {T}: The next instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn costs {X} less to cast, where X is the number of Wizards you control as this ability resolves.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no one-shot cost reduction for the next instant or sorcery spell cast this turn sized by the Wizards you control as the ability resolves (costReduction is a standing rule static).

cards.name: Termination Facilitator
lines: Whenever a creature or planeswalker an opponent controls with a bounty counter on it is dealt damage, destroy it.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever a creature or planeswalker an opponent controls that has a bounty counter on it is dealt damage, destroy that permanent.

cards.name: Vulpine Harvester
lines: Whenever one or more Phyrexians you control attack, return target artifact card from your graveyard to the battlefield if its mana value is less than or equal to their total power.
validatorIssues: override.def.triggers[0].effects[0].condition.left.target: cardInGraveyard is incompatible with effect domains permanent, spell
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema cannot compare a targeted graveyard card's mana value against the total power of the attacking Phyrexians (manaValueOfTarget cannot reference a cardInGraveyard target, and target filters take only constants).

cards.name: Bounty of Skemfar
lines: Reveal the top six cards of your library. You may put up to one land card from among them onto the battlefield tapped and up to one Elf card from among them into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The look-at-top-six pick takes one filter with one destination, but this needs one land put onto the battlefield tapped and one Elf put into hand as two separate optional choices.

cards.name: Deathcap Cultivator
lines: ~ has deathtouch as long as there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
cards.backTranslation: This creature has deathtouch as long as there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.

cards.name: Jadelight Spelunker
lines: When this creature enters, it explores X times.
cards.inexpressibleReason: 'It explores X times' needs an explore repeated a variable number of times, and the explore effect takes no count.

cards.name: Silver Scrutiny
lines: You may cast this spell as though it had flash if X is 3 or less.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The flash permission applies only 'if X is 3 or less', and the schema's announcedXAtLeast condition can express only a lower bound, not an upper bound on X.

cards.name: Experimental Synthesizer
lines: When this artifact enters or leaves the battlefield, exile the top card of your library. Until end of turn, you may play that card.
cards.backTranslation:
When this artifact enters, exile the top card of your library. Until end of turn, you may play that card.
When this artifact leaves the battlefield, exile the top card of your library. Until end of turn, you may play that card.

cards.name: Optimistic Scavenger
lines: Eerie — Whenever an enchantment you control enters and whenever you fully unlock a Room, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no trigger for fully unlocking a Room, so the Eerie line's second trigger cannot be stated.

cards.name: Thought Reflection
lines: If you would draw a card, draw two cards instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no draw-replacement static that makes each card drawn become two cards (no draw multiplier exists among ruleStatics or staticEffects).

cards.name: Browbeat
lines: Any player may have ~ deal 5 damage to them. If no one does, target player draws three cards.
cards.inexpressibleReason: 'Any player may have Browbeat deal 5 damage to them; if no one does' is a per-player optional choice with a fallback draw, and the schema has no such op.

cards.name: Kindred Judgment
lines: Choose a creature type. Destroy all creatures that aren't of the chosen type.
cards.inexpressibleReason: 'Choose a creature type' as this sorcery resolves, then destroy all creatures not of that type, has no schema form: entersChoosingOption applies only as a permanent enters.

cards.name: Critical Hit
lines: When you roll a natural 20, return this card from your graveyard to your hand.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no die-roll event, so 'when you roll a natural 20' cannot be stated.

cards.name: Su-Chi Cave Guard
lines: When this creature dies, add eight {C}. Until end of turn, you don't lose this mana as steps and phases end.
cards.backTranslation: When this creature dies, add {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}{C}{C}{C}. That mana is persistent.
differences: Text A's mana is kept past steps and phases only until end of turn; Text B says only that the mana is persistent, with no until-end-of-turn duration.

cards.name: Mobilized District
lines: {4}: ~ becomes a 3/3 Citizen creature with vigilance until end of turn. It's still a land. This ability costs {1} less to activate for each legendary creature and planeswalker you control.
cards.backTranslation:
{4}: Until end of turn, this land becomes a 3/3 Citizen creature with vigilance.
This ability costs {1} less to activate for each permanent you control that is a legendary creature or a planeswalker.

cards.name: Tempt with Reflections
lines: Choose target creature you control. Create a token that's a copy of that creature. Each opponent may create a token that's a copy of that creature. For each opponent who does, create a token that's a copy of that creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Each opponent's optional ('may') token copy has no schema form: createTokenCopyOf with eachOpponent makes the copies mandatory, and no per-opponent choice gates them.

cards.name: Bleeding Effect
lines: At the beginning of combat on your turn, creatures you control gain flying until end of turn if a creature card in your graveyard has flying. The same is true for first strike, double strike, deathtouch, hexproof, indestructible, lifelink, menace, reach, trample, and vigilance.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No condition or count reads whether a creature card in your graveyard has a given keyword, so the per-keyword 'if a creature card in your graveyard has flying' gate cannot be stated.

cards.name: Hidetsugu and Kairi
lines: When ~ dies, exile the top card of your library. Target opponent loses life equal to its mana value. If it's an instant or sorcery card, you may cast it without paying its mana cost.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No Value reads the mana value of the card just exiled from the library, so 'target opponent loses life equal to its mana value' cannot be stated, and exileLibraryTop with castFree cannot restrict the free cast to instant or sorcery cards.

cards.name: Wrath of the Skies
lines: You get X {E} , then you may pay any amount of {E}. Destroy each artifact, creature, and enchantment with mana value less than or equal to the amount of {E} paid this way.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The destroy filter needs mana value at most the energy paid, and manaValueAtMost takes only a fixed number.

cards.name: Travel the Overworld
lines: Affinity for Towns
cards.backTranslation: This spell costs {1} less to cast for each Town you control.
differences: Text A is the spell's whole card with the Affinity for Towns line under test plus 'Draw four cards.'; Text B gives only the cost reduction and omits the spell's effect 'Draw four cards', which must be given when describing a spell's effects.

cards.name: Memories Returning
lines: Reveal the top five cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand. Then choose an opponent. They put one on the bottom of your library. Then you put one into your hand. Then they put one on the bottom of your library. Put the other into your hand.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The alternating sequence where an opponent chooses and puts cards on the bottom of your library, interleaved with your own picks, has no schema representation.

cards.name: Geistwave
lines: Return target nonland permanent to its owner's hand. If you controlled that permanent, draw a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The conditional draw depends on whether you controlled the target before it left the battlefield, and the schema gives no way to check the target's prior control ordered before the bounce (conditionalEffect checkTarget is documented only for checks on the resolved target).

cards.name: Syphon Flesh
lines: Each other player sacrifices a creature of their choice. You create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token for each creature sacrificed this way.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect makes a token count equal to the number of creatures sacrificed this way: sacrificeOneEachOpponent and sacrificeEachPlayer have no linked count for the createToken that follows.

cards.name: Stirring Hopesinger
lines: Repartee — Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell that targets a creature, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell that targets a creature, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.

cards.name: Kudo, King Among Bears
lines: Other creatures have base power and toughness 2/2 and are Bears in addition to their other types.
cards.backTranslation:
Other creatures are Bears in addition to their other creature types.
Other creatures have base power and toughness 2/2.

cards.name: Keening Stone
lines: {5}, {T}: Target player mills X cards, where X is the number of cards in that player's graveyard.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The mill effects take a fixed count or the controller's own library, with no way to make the number the card count of the target player's graveyard.

cards.name: Lazav, the Multifarious
lines: {X}: ~ becomes a copy of target creature card in your graveyard with mana value X, except its name is ~, it's legendary in addition to its other types, and it has this ability.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema cannot restrict the target creature card in your graveyard to a mana value equal to the announced X (manaValueAtMost and manaValueAtLeast take only constants), so the becomes-a-copy target cannot be exact.

cards.name: Standstill
lines: When a player casts a spell, sacrifice this enchantment. If you do, each of that player's opponents draws three cards.
cards.inexpressibleReason: 'Each of that player's opponents draws three cards' needs a draw scope relative to the spell's caster (the trigger's event player), and the schema offers draw scopes only relative to the controller or the event player themself.

cards.name: Puppet Strings
lines: {2}, {T}: You may tap or untap target creature.
cards.backTranslation:
{2}, {T}: You may choose one.
• Tap target creature.
• Untap target creature.

cards.name: Tellah, Great Sage
lines: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, create a 1/1 colorless Hero creature token. If four or more mana was spent to cast that spell, draw two cards. If eight or more mana was spent to cast that spell, sacrifice ~ and it deals that much damage to each opponent.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, create a 1/1 colorless Hero creature token. If at least four mana was spent to cast that spell, draw two cards. If at least eight mana was spent to cast that spell, sacrifice this creature and each opponent takes damage equal to the mana spent to cast that spell.
differences: Text A says Tellah itself (the sacrificed creature) deals the damage to each opponent; Text B says each opponent takes damage with no damage source named.

cards.name: Sphinx of Uthuun
lines: When this creature enters, reveal the top five cards of your library. An opponent separates those cards into two piles. Put one pile into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No op has an opponent separate the revealed cards into two piles that the controller then divides between hand and graveyard (the pile-separation ops are for attacker-limiting and sacrifice, not card piles).

cards.name: Unlicensed Disintegration
lines: Destroy target creature. If you control an artifact, ~ deals 3 damage to that creature's controller.
cards.backTranslation:
Target creature.
If you control an artifact, this spell deals 3 damage to that creature's controller.
Destroy that creature.
differences: Step order differs: Text A destroys the target creature first and then, if you control an artifact, deals 3 damage to its controller; Text B checks for an artifact and deals the damage before destroying the creature. If the target is an artifact you control, destroying it first removes the condition, so the damage would not happen in Text A but would in Text B.
Text B's 'Target creature.' is a bare target line with the destruction moved to the end; the overall step sequence is not the same as Text A.

cards.name: Aven Wind Guide
lines: Embalm {4}{W}{U}
cards.inexpressibleReason: Embalm's token must be a white Zombie with no mana cost, and createTokenCopyOf cannot change the copy's color or subtype or remove its mana cost.

cards.name: Compost
lines: Whenever a black card is put into an opponent's graveyard from anywhere, you may draw a card.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever a black permanent you don't own is put into a graveyard from anywhere, you may draw a card.
differences: Text A triggers on any black card (spells included) put into an opponent's graveyard from anywhere; Text B triggers only on a black permanent, so a black instant or sorcery going to the graveyard does not trigger Text B.

cards.name: Demonic Taskmaster
lines: At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice a creature other than this creature.
cards.backTranslation: At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice a creature you control other than this creature.

cards.name: Legolas, Counter of Kills
lines: Whenever you scry, if ~ is tapped, you may untap it. Do this only once each turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no trigger for "whenever you scry", so the untap-once-each-turn ability on scry cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Thunderdrum Soloist
lines: Opus — Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, this creature deals 1 damage to each opponent. If five or more mana was spent to cast that spell, this creature deals 3 damage to each opponent instead.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, if five or more mana was spent to cast that spell, each opponent takes 3 damage. Otherwise, each opponent takes 1 damage.

cards.name: Gruesome Slaughter
lines: Until end of turn, colorless creatures you control gain "{T}: ~ deals damage equal to its power to target creature."
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect grants a granted activated tap-damage ability to every colorless creature you control until end of turn (grantAbilityUntilEot takes a single target).

cards.name: Bygone Marvels
lines: Descend 8 — When you cast this spell, if there are eight or more permanent cards in your graveyard, copy this spell twice. You may choose new targets for the copies.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no 'when you cast this spell' trigger on the spell itself with an intervening graveyard-count condition, and no cast-time copy effect that makes exactly two copies (copyCastSpell copies once).

cards.name: Inspiration from Beyond
lines: Mill three cards, then return an instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
cards.backTranslation:
Mill three cards.
Return an instant or sorcery card from a graveyard to hand.
differences: Text A returns an instant or sorcery card from your graveyard; Text B returns one from any graveyard.

cards.name: Even the Score
lines: This spell costs {U}{U}{U} less to cast if an opponent has drawn four or more cards this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no condition for "an opponent has drawn four or more cards this turn" (eventPlayerDrawCount reads a trigger event, not a per-turn draw tally), so the cost reduction's condition cannot be stated.

cards.name: Grove of the Guardian
lines: {3}{G}{W}, {T}, Tap two untapped creatures you control, Sacrifice this land: Create an 8/8 green and white Elemental creature token with vigilance.
cards.backTranslation: {3}{G}{W}, {T}, Tap two creatures you control, Sacrifice this land: Create an 8/8 green and white Elemental creature token with vigilance. Activate at any time.
differences: Text A taps two untapped creatures you control as a cost; Text B says tap two creatures you control, dropping the requirement that they be untapped.

cards.name: Mystical Teachings
lines: Search your library for an instant card or a card with flash, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The only keyword selector (hasKeyword, for 'a card with flash') is event-only, so a library search filter for 'an instant card or a card with flash' cannot be stated.

cards.name: Resolute Archangel
lines: When this creature enters, if your life total is less than your starting life total, it becomes equal to your starting life total.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no operation that sets your life total to your starting life total, and no value for the starting life total.

cards.name: Khorvath's Fury
lines: For each player, choose friend or foe. Each friend discards all cards from their hand, then draws that many cards plus one. ~ deals damage to each foe equal to the number of cards in their hand.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Each player's friend-or-foe choice, with friends discarding and redrawing and each foe taking damage equal to its own hand size, has no schema form.

cards.name: Scouting Hawk
lines: Keen Sight — When this creature enters, if an opponent controls more lands than you, search your library for a basic Plains card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
cards.backTranslation: When this creature enters, if an opponent controls more lands than you do, search your library for a basic Plains card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.

cards.name: Hijack
lines: Gain control of target artifact or creature until end of turn. Untap it. It gains haste until end of turn.
cards.backTranslation: Gain control of target artifact or creature until end of turn. Untap that permanent. It gains haste until end of turn.

cards.name: Unesh, Criosphinx Sovereign
lines: Whenever ~ or another Sphinx you control enters, reveal the top four cards of your library. An opponent separates those cards into two piles. Put one pile into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no effect where an opponent separates the top four library cards into two piles and the controller takes one pile into hand and the other into the graveyard.

cards.name: Clever Conjurer
lines: Mage Hand — {T}: Untap target permanent not named ~. Activate only as a sorcery.
cards.backTranslation: {T}: Untap target permanent other than this creature. Activate only as a sorcery.

cards.name: Mob Justice
lines: ~ deals damage to target player or planeswalker equal to the number of creatures you control.
cards.backTranslation: This spell deals damage to target player or planeswalker equal to the number of creatures you control.

cards.name: Micromancer
lines: When this creature enters, you may search your library for an instant or sorcery card with mana value 1, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
cards.backTranslation: When this creature enters, you may search your library for an instant or sorcery card with mana value 1, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

cards.name: Geometer's Arthropod
lines: Whenever you cast a spell with {X} in its mana cost, look at the top X cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No selector matches a spell whose mana cost contains {X}, and 'look at the top X cards' needs the cast spell's announced X, which no Value reads.

cards.name: Whiskervale Forerunner
lines: Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability you control for the first time each turn, look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a creature card with mana value 3 or less from among them. You may put it onto the battlefield if it's your turn. If you don't put it onto the battlefield, put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The becomesTargeted trigger cannot be limited to spells or abilities its controller controls, and the 'put it onto the battlefield if it's your turn, otherwise into your hand' choice has no schema form.

cards.name: Mana Cannons
lines: Whenever you cast a multicolored spell, this enchantment deals X damage to any target, where X is the number of colors that spell is.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no selector for a multicolored spell, and no selector that excludes colorless spells, so 'whenever you cast a multicolored spell' cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Davros, Dalek Creator
lines: At the beginning of your end step, create a 3/3 black Dalek artifact creature token with menace if an opponent lost 3 or more life this turn. Then each opponent who lost 3 or more life this turn faces a villainous choice — You draw a card, or that player discards a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The villainous choice (each opponent who lost 3 or more life chooses whether you draw a card or that player discards a card) has no IR op, so the end-step line cannot be written exactly.

cards.name: Preeminent Captain
lines: Whenever this creature attacks, you may put a Soldier creature card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
cards.inexpressibleReason: handToBattlefield cannot put a card onto the battlefield tapped and attacking, and no other op puts a card from hand onto the battlefield attacking.

cards.name: Warchief Giant
lines: Myriad
cards.inexpressibleReason: Myriad needs a tapped-and-attacking token copy per other opponent that is exiled at end of combat; the schema has no exile-at-end-of-combat copy and no tapped-attacking copy op.

cards.name: Thran Temporal Gateway
lines: {4}, {T}: You may put a historic permanent card from your hand onto the battlefield.
cards.backTranslation: {4}, {T}: Put one card from hand onto the battlefield. The card must be an artifact, a legendary card, or a Saga card. Activate at any time.
differences: Text A says you may put a historic permanent card from hand onto the battlefield (optional); Text B says put one card from hand onto the battlefield with no option to decline (mandatory).

cards.name: Rampage of the Valkyries
lines: Whenever an Angel you control dies, each other player sacrifices a creature of their choice.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever an Angel you control dies, each opponent sacrifices a creature.
differences: Text A makes each other player (every player except the controller) sacrifice a creature; Text B makes each opponent sacrifice a creature, which excludes any non-opponent player in a multiplayer game.

cards.name: Candlekeep Inspiration
lines: Until end of turn, creatures you control have base power and toughness X/X, where X is the number of cards you own in exile and in your graveyard that are instant cards, are sorcery cards, and/or have an Adventure.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The base P/T value counts the owner's cards across exile and graveyard that are instant, sorcery, or have an Adventure, and countCardsInZone reads one zone with one selector, so the combined count cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Fix What's Broken
lines: Return each artifact and creature card with mana value X from your graveyard to the battlefield.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The graveyard filter needs mana value equal to the announced X, and manaValueAtMost and manaValueAtLeast take only fixed numbers.

cards.name: Planar Atlas
lines: When this artifact enters, you may look at the top four cards of your library. If you do, reveal up to one land card from among them, then put that card on top of your library and the rest on the bottom in a random order.
cards.backTranslation: When this enters, look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal a land card from among them and put it on top of your library. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in random order.
differences: Text A says you may look at the top four cards; Text B makes the look mandatory, so the rest of the ability happens without the option to decline.
Text A's reveal of a land card is conditional on having looked ('If you do') and is optional for up to one card; Text B's structure does not match that conditional sequence.

cards.name: Make Your Own Luck
lines: Look at the top three cards of your library. You may exile a nonland card from among them. If you do, it becomes plotted. Put the rest into your hand.
cards.inexpressibleReason: lookAtTopN cannot exile the chosen nonland card to become plotted, and its rest destinations do not include putting the rest into hand.

cards.name: One with the Kami
lines: Whenever enchanted creature or another modified creature you control dies, create X 1/1 colorless Spirit creature tokens, where X is that creature's power.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no selector for a 'modified' creature: isEquipped does not restrict the Equipment to one you control, so 'another modified creature you control' cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Tawnos, the Toymaker
lines: Whenever you cast a Beast or Bird creature spell, you may copy it, except the copy is an artifact in addition to its other types.
cards.inexpressibleReason: copyCastSpell cannot make the copy an artifact in addition to its other types (no addTypes on the spell copy), so the copy would be wrong.

cards.name: Aluren
lines: Any player may cast creature spells with mana value 3 or less without paying their mana costs and as though they had flash.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No ruleStatic lets any player cast creature spells of a given mana value for free and as though they had flash; castFromZone only covers the top of a library.

cards.name: Seedship Impact
lines: Destroy target artifact or enchantment. If its mana value was 2 or less, create a Lander token.
cards.backTranslation:
Destroy target artifact or enchantment.
If that permanent's mana value was 2 or less, create a colorless Lander artifact token with the subtype Lander, with no power or toughness, and with the following ability: "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle."

cards.name: Kamahl, Fist of Krosa
lines: {G}: Target land becomes a 1/1 creature until end of turn. It's still a land.
cards.backTranslation: {G}: Target land becomes a 1/1 creature with no creature types and no keyword abilities until end of turn. Activate at any time.

cards.name: Slumbering Trudge
lines: ~ enters with a number of stun counters on it equal to three minus X. If X is 2 or less, it enters tapped.
cards.backTranslation:
This creature enters tapped unless the announced X is 3 or more.
This creature enters with a number of stun counters on it equal to 3 minus X.

cards.name: Audience with Trostani
lines: Create a 0/1 green Plant creature token, then draw cards equal to the number of differently named creature tokens you control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no count of differently named creature tokens you control, so the number of cards drawn cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Gold Rush
lines: Create a Treasure token. Until end of turn, up to one target creature gets +2/+2 for each Treasure you control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The up-to-one target creature gets +2/+2 per Treasure, and no pump op acts on an optional chosen target slot (only putCountersEachChosen and grantKeywordEachChosenUntilEot take a target slot), so the zero-target case cannot be written.

cards.name: Orochi Merge-Keeper
lines: As long as this creature is modified, it has "{T}: Add {G}{G}."
cards.inexpressibleReason: "Modified" (counters, or equipped by an Equipment you control, or enchanted by an Aura you control) cannot be stated exactly: isEquipped does not restrict to an Equipment you control, so no condition or selector matches the printed definition.

cards.name: Splinter, Hamato Yoshi
lines: Sneak {B}
cards.backTranslation: You may cast this spell by paying {B} and returning an unblocked attacking creature you control to its owner's hand, rather than paying its mana cost. You may do so only during your turn, during the declare blockers step. This spell may be cast at instant speed in that way.
differences: Text A says the creature returned for Sneak's cost enters the battlefield tapped and attacking (reminder text); Text B omits this entirely.
Text B restricts casting to 'only during your turn'; Text A (reminder text) only requires the declare blockers step and says nothing about whose turn.

cards.name: Fire Prophecy
lines: ~ deals 3 damage to target creature. You may put a card from your hand on the bottom of your library. If you do, draw a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: 'You may put a card from your hand on the bottom of your library, then draw' has no exact op: putAnyFromHandOnBottomThenDraw allows any number of cards, not at most one.

cards.name: Hammerheim
lines: {T}: Target creature loses all landwalk abilities until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect removes landwalk abilities from a target until end of turn (landwalk is not in the keyword list, and deny/remove-keyword effects only take KeywordAbility values).

cards.name: Rocksteady, Mutant Marauder
lines: Partner with Bebop, Skull & Crossbones
cards.backTranslation: When this creature enters, target player may search their library for a card with the hidden name given by this ability.
differences: Text A has a target player who may put the named card (Bebop) into their hand from their library; Text B only says the player may search for a card with a hidden name, without saying the card goes into hand.
Text A ends with shuffling the library; Text B does not mention a shuffle.

cards.name: Thieves' Auction
lines: Exile all nontoken permanents. Starting with you, each player chooses one of the exiled cards and puts it onto the battlefield tapped under their control. Repeat this process until all cards exiled this way have been chosen.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect has each player in APNAP order choose one of the exiled cards and put it onto the battlefield under their control, repeated until all are chosen.

cards.name: Return to the Light Realms
lines: Return all nonland permanent cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
cards.backTranslation: Put each card in a graveyard that is a nonland creature, artifact, enchantment, planeswalker, or battle card onto the battlefield.
differences: Text A returns only nonland permanent cards from YOUR graveyard; Text B puts qualifying cards from EACH graveyard (any player's) onto the battlefield, so opponents' graveyards are affected.

cards.name: Perilous Research
lines: Draw two cards, then sacrifice a permanent.
cards.backTranslation: Draw two cards. Then sacrifice one thing you control.

cards.name: Mandibular Kite
lines: Living weapon
cards.backTranslation: When this enters, create a 0/0 black Phyrexian Germ creature token. Attach this to that token.

cards.name: Fateful Handoff
lines: Draw cards equal to the mana value of target artifact or creature you control. An opponent gains control of that permanent.
cards.backTranslation:
Target permanent you control that is an artifact or creature.
Draw a number of cards equal to the mana value of that permanent.
Then an opponent you choose gains control of that permanent.
differences: Text A says an opponent gains control without saying who chooses that opponent; Text B says an opponent you (the caster) choose gains control.

cards.name: Savage Summoning
lines: The next creature spell you cast this turn can be cast as though it had flash. That spell can't be countered. That creature enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no way to let the next creature spell be cast as though it had flash, so the flash permission for that spell cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Talion's Messenger
lines: Whenever you attack with one or more Faeries, draw a card, then discard a card. When you discard a card this way, put a +1/+1 counter on target Faerie you control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The second ability ('When you discard a card this way') is a reflexive trigger tied to this ability's own discard, and no effect or trigger expresses that; discardsCard would also fire for discards from other sources.

cards.name: Counterpoint
lines: Counter target spell. You may cast a creature, instant, sorcery, or planeswalker spell from your graveyard with mana value less than or equal to that spell's mana value without paying its mana cost.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no effect that lets the controller cast a creature, instant, sorcery, or planeswalker spell from their graveyard for free with mana value up to the countered spell's; the free-cast effects only read hand or library cards.

cards.name: Netherborn Altar
lines: {T}, Put a soul counter on this artifact: Put your commander into your hand from the command zone. Then you lose 3 life for each soul counter on this artifact.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The cost "Put a soul counter on this artifact" is a counter-placement activation cost, and the schema's AbilityCost kinds have no way to place counters as a cost (only removeCounters and removeCountersFromAmong).

cards.name: Arcane Laboratory
lines: Each player can't cast more than one spell each turn.
cards.backTranslation: Only one spell of any category can be cast each turn.
differences: Text A limits each player to casting one spell per turn; Text B allows only one spell in total per turn across all players, of any category.

cards.name: High-Speed Hoverbike
lines: When this Vehicle enters, tap up to one target creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no tap-only effect over an up-to-one chosen target slot: tapTarget takes a single target and tapAndGoadEachChosen also goads, so "tap up to one target creature" cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Power Artifact
lines: Enchanted artifact's activated abilities cost {2} less to activate. This effect can't reduce the mana in that cost to less than one mana.
cards.inexpressibleReason: costReduction with appliesTo 'activate' has no way to scope the reduction to the enchanted permanent's activated abilities regardless of controller (its filter is a printed-spell filter and graveyardAbilities/boastOnly are fixed categories), so the attached-artifact activation reduction cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Chrome Companion
lines: {2}, {T}: Put target card from a graveyard on the bottom of its owner's library.
cards.backTranslation: {2}, {T}: Put target card from a graveyard on the bottom of its owner's library.

cards.name: Rowdy Research
lines: This spell costs {1} less to cast for each creature that attacked this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No Value counts the creatures that attacked this turn (attackingCreatures counts only those attacking now), so the cost reduction cannot be stated.

cards.name: Wildest Dreams
lines: Return X target cards from your graveyard to your hand. Exile ~.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The number of target cards equals the announced X, but TargetSpec.count takes only fixed min and max numbers, and no op returns several chosen graveyard cards to hand.

cards.name: Quest for the Necropolis
lines: {5}{B}, Sacrifice this enchantment: Put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. This ability costs {1} less to activate for each quest counter on this enchantment. Activate only as a sorcery.
cards.backTranslation:
This permanent's activated abilities cost {1} less to activate for each quest counter on this permanent.
{5}{B}, Sacrifice this permanent: Put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
differences: Text A puts the creature card onto the battlefield under your control; Text B omits 'under your control', so the creature would enter under its owner's control.

cards.name: Ojutai, Soul of Winter
lines: Whenever a Dragon you control attacks, tap target nonland permanent an opponent controls. That permanent doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The clause 'that permanent doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step' has no exact schema form: the only untap-skip is the card-level doesntUntapDuringUntapStep flag, and a stun counter would only approximate it.

cards.name: Dragon Arch
lines: {2}, {T}: You may put a multicolored creature card from your hand onto the battlefield.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The selector has no multicolored leaf (only isMonocolored), and not(isMonocolored) would also match colorless creature cards, which are not multicolored.

cards.name: Ghouls' Night Out
lines: For each player, choose a creature card in that player's graveyard. Put those cards onto the battlefield under your control. They're black Zombies in addition to their other colors and types and they gain decayed.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Choosing one creature card from each player's graveyard and giving those cards the 'gains decayed' keyword have no schema form (decayed is not an implemented keyword).

cards.name: Myr Propagator
lines: {3}, {T}: Create a token that's a copy of this creature.

cards.name: Atemsis, All-Seeing
lines: Whenever ~ deals damage to an opponent, you may reveal your hand. If cards with at least six different mana values are revealed this way, that player loses the game.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Neither 'cards with at least six different mana values are revealed' nor 'that player loses the game' has an expression in the schema.

cards.name: Thirst for Identity
lines: Draw three cards. Then discard two cards unless you discard a creature card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: 'Discard two cards unless you discard a creature card' is an either-or discard choice that no effect in the schema expresses.

cards.name: Scrap Welder
lines: {T}, Sacrifice an artifact with mana value X: Return target artifact card with mana value less than X from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains haste until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No selector or Value ties the sacrificed artifact's mana value to the target filter 'mana value less than X' and the announced X, so the sacrifice-and-return cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Mythos of Nethroi
lines: Destroy target nonland permanent if it's a creature or if {G}{W} was spent to cast this spell.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no condition for whether specific colored mana ({G}{W}) was spent to cast the spell, so the second destroy mode cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Champion of the Flame
lines: ~ gets +2/+2 for each Aura and Equipment attached to it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No value counts the Auras and Equipment attached to this creature: aurasAttachedToSource counts only Auras, and no selector or value counts Equipment attached to the source.

cards.name: Pull Through the Weft
lines: Return up to two target nonland permanent cards from your graveyard to your hand, then return up to two target land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Returning up to two chosen graveyard cards to hand has no each-chosen op (graveyardToHand takes a single target), so the variable-count hand half cannot be expressed exactly.

cards.name: In the Trenches
lines: {5}{W}: Exile target nonland permanent you don't control until this enchantment leaves the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery and only once.
cards.backTranslation: {5}{W}, Exhaust: Exile target nonland permanent an opponent controls until this leaves the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.

cards.name: Moonblade Shinobi
lines: Ninjutsu {2}{U}
cards.inexpressibleReason: Ninjutsu's effect, putting this card from hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking, has no op in the schema.

cards.name: Mutalith Vortex Beast
lines: Warp Vortex — When this creature enters, flip a coin for each opponent you have. For each flip you win, draw a card. For each flip you lose, this creature deals 3 damage to that player.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The Warp Vortex trigger flips a separate coin for each opponent and branches per flip (draw on a win, 3 damage to that player on a loss), and the schema's flipCoin is a single flip with no per-opponent loop.

cards.name: Dropkick Bomber
lines: {R}: Until end of turn, another target Goblin you control gains flying and "When this creature deals combat damage, sacrifice it."
cards.inexpressibleReason: The granted 'When this creature deals combat damage, sacrifice it' needs a trigger for combat damage to any object, but the schema only has combat-damage triggers for damage to a player.

cards.name: Sphinx Ambassador
lines: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, search that player's library for a card, then that player chooses a card name. If you searched for a creature card that doesn't have that name, you may put it onto the battlefield under your control. Then that player shuffles.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Searching the damaged player's library, having that player name a card, and putting a creature onto the battlefield if its name differs has no schema form (no op for a player-chosen card name).

cards.name: Raiders' Karve
lines: Whenever this Vehicle attacks, look at the top card of your library. If it's a land card, you may put it onto the battlefield tapped.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever this artifact attacks, look at the top card of your library. You may put a land card from among them onto the battlefield tapped. Put the rest on top of your library in any order.

cards.name: Aang and Katara
lines: Whenever ~ enter or attack, create X 1/1 white Ally creature tokens, where X is the number of tapped artifacts and/or creatures you control.
cards.backTranslation:
When this creature enters, create a 1/1 white Ally creature token for each tapped artifact or creature you control.
Whenever this creature attacks, create a 1/1 white Ally creature token for each tapped artifact or creature you control.

cards.name: Pox
lines: Each player loses a third of their life, then discards a third of the cards in their hand, then sacrifices a third of the creatures they control of their choice, then sacrifices a third of the lands they control of their choice. Round up each time.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Each step takes a third of a quantity rounded up, and no Value expresses that division for life, hand, creatures or lands.

cards.name: Feral Hydra
lines: {3}: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. Any player may activate this ability.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Activated abilities have no controller field, so "Any player may activate this ability" (usable by players other than the creature's controller) cannot be stated.

cards.name: Balthor the Defiled
lines: {B}{B}{B}, Exile ~: Each player returns all black and all red creature cards from their graveyard to the battlefield.
cards.backTranslation: {B}{B}{B}, Exile this creature: Put each black or red creature card from all graveyards onto the battlefield. Activate at any time.
differences: Text A returns black and red creature cards from each player's own graveyard; Text B puts black or red creature cards from all graveyards onto the battlefield, which includes graveyards other than each player's own.

cards.name: Cavalcade of Calamity
lines: Whenever a creature you control with power 1 or less attacks, this enchantment deals 1 damage to the player or planeswalker that creature is attacking.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The damage must go to the player or planeswalker the creature is attacking, and the schema's damage references reach only the attacked player (eventPlayer), not an attacked planeswalker.

cards.name: Arwen's Gift
lines: This spell costs {1} less to cast if you control two or more legendary creatures.
cards.backTranslation: This spell costs {1} less to cast if you control two or more legendary creatures.

cards.name: Dying to Serve
lines: Whenever you discard one or more cards, create a tapped 2/2 black Zombie creature token. This ability triggers only once each turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The discardsCard trigger head has no once-each-turn limit or aggregate form, so 'one or more cards' and 'triggers only once each turn' cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Haunted Crossroads
lines: {B}: Put target creature card from your graveyard on top of your library.
cards.backTranslation: {B}: Put target creature card from your graveyard on top of your library.

cards.name: Unending Whisper
lines: Harmonize {5}{U}
cards.backTranslation: You may cast this spell from your graveyard by paying {5}{U} rather than paying its mana cost. If a spell cast this way would resolve, exile it instead.
differences: Text A's harmonize reminder lets you tap a creature you control to reduce the harmonize cost by that creature's power; Text B gives only the {5}{U} cost with no creature-tap cost reduction.

Text A's reminder exiles the spell after it is cast from the graveyard ("Then exile this spell"), unconditionally; Text B exiles it only if it would resolve, so a cast spell that does not resolve stays out of exile in Text B.

cards.name: Chromeshell Crab
lines: When this creature is turned face up, you may exchange control of target creature you control and target creature an opponent controls.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No op permanently exchanges control of a creature you control with a creature an opponent controls (swapCreatureControlUntilEot only lasts until end of turn).

cards.name: The Mimeoplasm
lines: As ~ enters, you may exile two creature cards from graveyards. If you do, it enters as a copy of one of those cards with a number of additional +1/+1 counters on it equal to the power of the other card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The extra +1/+1 counters equal the power of the other exiled card, and entersAsCopy cannot restrict its candidates to the two exiled cards or read their power.

cards.name: Let the Galaxy Burn
lines: ~ deals X plus 2 damage to each creature that didn't enter this turn.
cards.backTranslation: Each creature that didn't enter the battlefield this turn is dealt X plus 2 damage.

cards.name: Mark of Mutiny
lines: Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Put a +1/+1 counter on it and untap it. That creature gains haste until end of turn.
cards.backTranslation: Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn. Put a +1/+1 counter on that creature.

cards.name: Thorn of the Black Rose
lines: When this creature enters, you become the monarch.
cards.backTranslation: When this creature enters, you become the monarch.

cards.name: Hunted by The Family
lines: Choose up to four target creatures you don't control. For each of them, that creature's controller faces a villainous choice — That creature becomes a 1/1 white Human creature and loses all abilities, or you create a token that's a copy of it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The villainous choice, where the creature's controller picks between becoming a 1/1 Human with no abilities or you copying it, has no op in the schema.

cards.name: Reprocess
lines: Sacrifice any number of artifacts, creatures, and/or lands. Draw a card for each permanent sacrificed this way.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no effect for sacrificing any number of chosen permanents by the controller and then drawing one card per permanent sacrificed this way.

cards.name: Falkenrath Pit Fighter
lines: {1}{R}, Discard a card, Sacrifice a Vampire: Draw two cards. Activate only if an opponent lost life this turn.
cards.backTranslation: {1}{R}, Discard a card, Sacrifice a Vampire, which may be this creature: Draw two cards. Activate only if an opponent lost life this turn.

cards.name: Echoing Truth
lines: Return target nonland permanent and all other permanents with the same name as that permanent to their owners' hands.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No selector matches permanents with the same name as the chosen target (sameNameAsSource reads the source's name, and name takes a fixed value), so "all other permanents with the same name as that permanent" cannot be stated.

cards.name: Finale of Eternity
lines: Destroy up to three target creatures with toughness X or less. If X is 10 or more, return all creature cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no target selector for 'toughness X or less' (Selector has only toughnessAtLeast), so 'up to three target creatures with toughness X or less' cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Deprive
lines: As an additional cost to cast this spell, return a land you control to its owner's hand.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no additional-cost component for returning a land you control to its owner's hand (AbilityCost has no bounce-a-permanent cost).

cards.name: Sierra, Nuka's Biggest Fan
lines: Whenever you sacrifice a Food, target creature you control gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of quest counters on ~.
validatorIssues: unrecognized rules text: "The Nuka-Cola Challenge — Whenever one or more creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, put a quest counter on ~ and create a Food token."
cards.inexpressibleReason: Line 2 is expressible, but any non-empty patch stops the interpreter stripping the generic label from the already-parsed line 1 ("The Nuka-Cola Challenge —"), which then reports as unrecognized and the patch cannot claim it.

cards.name: Elrond of the White Council
lines: When ~ enters, each player secretly votes for fellowship or aid, then those votes are revealed. For each fellowship vote, the voter chooses a creature they control. You gain control of each creature chosen this way, and they gain "~ can't attack its owner." Then for each aid vote, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The votes are secret and simultaneous (only councilVote, a public vote, exists), and the chosen creatures gain the granted text "can't attack its owner", which no schema op can express.

cards.name: Dragonstorm
lines: Search your library for a Dragon permanent card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
cards.backTranslation: Search your library for a card with the Dragon creature type that is not an instant or sorcery card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
differences: Text A's spell has Storm (copy it for each spell cast before it this turn); Text B gives only the search effect and omits storm entirely, although B gives the effect of a sorcery and must give every effect of the whole spell.

cards.name: Ideas Unbound
lines: Draw three cards. Discard three cards at the beginning of the next end step.
cards.backTranslation:
Draw three cards.
Create a delayed triggered ability. At the beginning of the end step, discard three cards. Then this delayed ability expires.

cards.name: Sudden Edict
lines: Target player sacrifices a creature of their choice.
cards.backTranslation: Target player sacrifices a creature.
differences: Text A's spell has split second (players can't cast spells or activate non-mana abilities while it is on the stack); Text B omits split second.

cards.name: Become Immense
lines: Delve
cards.inexpressibleReason: Delve (exiling cards from your graveyard to pay generic mana while casting) has no schema form.

cards.name: Warmaker Gunship
lines: When this Spacecraft enters, it deals damage equal to the number of artifacts you control to target creature an opponent controls.
cards.backTranslation: When this Spacecraft enters, it deals damage equal to the number of artifacts you control to target creature an opponent controls.

cards.name: Merfolk Trickster
lines: When this creature enters, tap target creature an opponent controls. It loses all abilities until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no effect that makes a target creature lose all abilities until end of turn (loseAllAbilities exists only as a permanent static layer-6 op), so the second sentence cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Sail into the West
lines: Starting with you, each player votes for return or embark. If return gets more votes, each player returns up to two cards from their graveyard to their hand, then you exile ~. If embark gets more votes or the vote is tied, each player may discard their hand and draw seven cards.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no effect where each player returns up to two cards from their own graveyard to their hand, so the 'return' branch of the vote cannot be modeled.

cards.name: Gaea's Touch
lines: {0}: You may put a basic Forest card from your hand onto the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery and only once each turn.
cards.backTranslation: {0}: Put a basic Forest card from hand onto the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery and only once each turn.
differences: Text A says you may put a basic Forest card from hand onto the battlefield (optional); Text B says put a basic Forest card from hand (mandatory, no option to decline).

cards.name: Dwalin, Weaponmaster
lines: Whenever ~ enters or attacks, put a hone counter on each Equipment you control.
cards.backTranslation:
When this creature enters, put a hone counter on each permanent you control that has the creature type Equipment.
Whenever this creature attacks, put a hone counter on each permanent you control that has the creature type Equipment.
differences: Text A puts hone counters on each Equipment you control (Equipment is an artifact subtype); Text B puts them on permanents with the creature type Equipment, which no permanent has, so the effect would hit nothing.

cards.name: Ironheart, Clever Champion
lines: Noncreature spells you cast have improvise.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No rule static grants improvise to other spells you cast; the improvise rule static applies only to the card itself.

cards.name: Multiversal Incursion
lines: For each nontoken creature you control, create a token that's a copy of that creature, except it isn't legendary.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No op creates one non-legendary token copy for each nontoken creature you control; createTokenCopyOf copies a single referent.

cards.name: Clattering Augur
lines: {2}{B}{B}: Return this card from your graveyard to your hand.
cards.backTranslation: {2}{B}{B}: Return this card from your graveyard to your hand.

cards.name: Garna, the Bloodflame
lines: When ~ enters, return to your hand all creature cards in your graveyard that were put there from anywhere this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The return only takes creature cards that were put into your graveyard from anywhere this turn, and the selector and graveyard ops have no way to restrict cards by having entered the graveyard this turn.

cards.name: Runechanter's Pike
lines: Equipped creature has first strike and gets +X/+0, where X is the number of instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard.
cards.backTranslation:
Equipped creature has first strike.
Equipped creature gets +X/+0, where X is the number of instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard.

cards.name: Nephalia Academy
lines: If a spell or ability an opponent controls causes you to discard a card, you may reveal that card and put it on top of your library instead of putting it anywhere else.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema's effectDiscardMayGoToLibraryTop applies to every discard effect, and no field restricts it to discards caused by spells or abilities an opponent controls.

cards.name: Brand
lines: Gain control of all permanents you own.
cards.backTranslation: You gain control, permanently, of each permanent whose owner is you.

cards.name: Sentinel Tower
lines: Whenever an instant or sorcery spell is cast during your turn, this artifact deals damage to any target equal to 1 plus the number of instant and sorcery spells cast before that spell this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No Value counts the instant and sorcery spells cast before the current one this turn, so the trigger's damage amount cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Bogslither's Embrace
lines: As an additional cost to cast this spell, blight 1 or pay {3}.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no blight cost (putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature you control) and no 'blight 1 or pay {3}' either-or additional cost.

cards.name: Oildeep Gearhulk
lines: When this creature enters, look at target player's hand. You may choose a card from it. If you do, that player discards that card, then draws a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: 'Look at' the target's hand, then an optional card choice followed by a discard and draw only if chosen, cannot be said, since revealHandAndDiscard reveals the hand and forces a choice.

cards.name: Shellshock
lines: For each opponent, choose up to one target creature that player controls. ~ deals X damage to each of those creatures. You create a Mutagen token for each creature dealt damage this way.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The number of Mutagen tokens equals the number of creatures dealt damage this way, and no Value counts that chosen set.

cards.name: Voice of Resurgence
lines: Whenever an opponent casts a spell during your turn and when this creature dies, create a green and white Elemental creature token with "~'s power and toughness are each equal to the number of creatures you control."
cards.backTranslation:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell during your turn, create a green and white Elemental creature token. Its power and toughness are each equal to the number of creatures you control.
Whenever this creature dies, create a green and white Elemental creature token. Its power and toughness are each equal to the number of creatures you control.

cards.name: Slash of Light
lines: ~ deals damage equal to the number of creatures you control plus the number of Equipment you control to target creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No single Value sums creatures you control plus Equipment you control: a countPermanents over anyOf(creature, Equipment) would count a creature that is also an Equipment once instead of twice.

cards.name: Loyal Retainers
lines: Sacrifice this creature: Return target legendary creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only during your turn, before attackers are declared.
cards.backTranslation: Sacrifice this creature: Put target legendary creature card from your graveyard onto the battlefield. Activate only during your turn and only before attackers are declared.

cards.name: Silverquill Lecturer
lines: Creature spells you cast have demonstrate.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Demonstrate is not a keyword in the schema's keyword list or any static, so granting it to creature spells you cast cannot be stated.

cards.name: Reinterpret
lines: Counter target spell. You may cast a spell with equal or lesser mana value from your hand without paying its mana cost.
cards.inexpressibleReason: castOneFromHandFreeUpTo takes a fixed maxManaValue number, not the countered spell's mana value, so 'equal or lesser mana value' cannot be stated.

cards.name: Eivor, Battle-Ready
lines: Whenever ~ attacks, it deals damage equal to the number of Equipment you control to each opponent.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever this creature attacks, each opponent is dealt damage equal to the number of Equipment you control.

cards.name: Cloudfin Raptor
lines: Evolve
cards.inexpressibleReason: Evolve compares the entering creature's toughness with this creature's, and no Value or selector reads an entering object's toughness.

cards.name: Deepfathom Echo
lines: At the beginning of combat on your turn, this creature explores. Then you may have it become a copy of another creature you control until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The explore is mandatory but the copy is optional ("you may"), and the only optional flag is on the whole trigger, which would make the explore optional too.

cards.name: Leather Armor
lines: Equip {0}. Activate only once each turn.
cards.backTranslation: {0}: Attach this to target creature you control. Activate only as a sorcery and only once each turn.

cards.name: Goblin Archaeologist
lines: {R}, {T}: Flip a coin. If you win the flip, destroy target artifact and untap this creature. If you lose the flip, sacrifice this creature.
cards.backTranslation: {R}, {T}: Flip a coin. If you win the flip, destroy target artifact and untap this creature. If you lose the flip, sacrifice this creature.

cards.name: Graywater's Fixer
lines: Each outlaw creature card in your graveyard has encore {X}, where X is its mana value.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Granting the encore {X} activated ability to outlaw creature cards in your graveyard (a graveyard-zone grant with a mana-value-derived cost) has no schema form; the only graveyard grants are for specific card permissions.

cards.name: Citanul Stalwart
lines: {T}, Tap an untapped artifact or creature you control: Add one mana of any color.
cards.backTranslation: {T}, Tap an artifact or creature you control (this creature may be the one tapped): Add one mana of any one of the colors white, blue, black, red, or green.

cards.name: Tower of the Magistrate
lines: {1}, {T}: Target creature gains protection from artifacts until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no protection quality for artifacts (ProtectionQuality is only colors, multicolored, or creatures), so 'target creature gains protection from artifacts' cannot be stated.

cards.name: Vault Robber
lines: {1}, {T}, Exile a creature card from your graveyard: Create a Treasure token.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No activation cost exiles a creature card from your own graveyard, since exileOtherCardsFromGraveyard takes no selector.

cards.name: Explosive Singularity
lines: As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may tap any number of untapped creatures you control. This spell costs {1} less to cast for each creature tapped this way.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The optional tap of any number of untapped creatures as an additional cost, reducing the generic cost by one per creature tapped, has no schema form (tapOthers takes a fixed count and no cost-reduction is tied to the tapped count).

cards.name: Penance
lines: Put a card from your hand on top of your library: The next time a black or red source of your choice would deal damage this turn, prevent that damage.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The activation cost 'put a card from your hand on top of your library' has no AbilityCost form, and the damage prevention cannot be limited to a black or red source of your choice.

cards.name: Curse of Echoes
lines: Whenever enchanted player casts an instant or sorcery spell, each other player may copy that spell and may choose new targets for the copy they control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The castsSpell trigger's caster has no option for the enchanted player, and the copy is offered to each other player rather than to the trigger's controller.

cards.name: Falcon and Redwing
lines: Whenever ~ deal combat damage to a player, create that many 1/1 white Bird creature tokens with flying, then put a +1/+1 counter on ~.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, create a number of 1/1 white Bird creature tokens with flying equal to the damage dealt. Then put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.

cards.name: Ob Nixilis of the Black Oath
lines: −8: You get an emblem with "{1}{B}, Sacrifice a creature: You gain X life and draw X cards, where X is the sacrificed creature's power."
cards.inexpressibleReason: No Value reads the power of a creature sacrificed as an activation cost, so the emblem's 'draw X cards and gain X life, where X is the sacrificed creature's power' cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Zurgo's Vanguard
lines: Mobilize 1
cards.inexpressibleReason: Mobilize's attacking Warrior token must be sacrificed at the beginning of the next end step, and createTokenAttacking has no sacrifice timing (only createTokenCopyOf does).

cards.name: Magister of Worth
lines: When this creature enters, starting with you, each player votes for grace or condemnation. If grace gets more votes, each player returns each creature card from their graveyard to the battlefield. If condemnation gets more votes or the vote is tied, destroy all creatures other than this creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The grace mode returns each player's own creature cards from their own graveyard under their owner's control, and graveyardToBattlefieldEach has no owner-control option (it would put opponents' cards under the controller of the ability).

cards.name: Relic Retriever
lines: At the beginning of each end step, if a card left your graveyard this turn, create a Treasure token.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no condition for 'if a card left your graveyard this turn', so the end-step intervening-if cannot be modeled.

cards.name: Whip Silk
lines: {G}: Return this Aura to its owner's hand.
cards.backTranslation: {G}: Return this to its owner's hand. Activate at any time.

cards.name: Increasing Confusion
lines: Target player mills X cards. If this spell was cast from a graveyard, that player mills twice that many cards instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: millTargetPlayer takes a fixed number of cards, not the announced X, and no other op mills a targeted player X cards (millEachPlayer only reaches scoped players, not the chosen target), so 'target player mills X cards' cannot be stated.

cards.name: Transmogrify
lines: Exile target creature. That creature's controller reveals cards from the top of their library until they reveal a creature card. That player puts that card onto the battlefield, then shuffles the rest into their library.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no effect that reveals cards from the top of a library until a creature card, puts that card onto the battlefield, and shuffles the rest into the library (revealUntilAura is Aura-only).

cards.name: Githzerai Monk
lines: Psychic Defense — When this creature enters, tap all creatures you don't control.
cards.backTranslation: When this creature enters, tap each creature your opponents control.

cards.name: Merfolk Cave-Diver
lines: Whenever a creature you control explores, this creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn and can't be blocked this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The trigger event 'a creature you control explores' has no TriggerHead when value (no explores event exists in the schema).

cards.name: Regal Sliver
lines: Sliver creatures you control have "When this creature enters, Slivers you control get +1/+1 until end of turn if you're the monarch. Otherwise, you become the monarch."
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no condition for 'if you're the monarch' (only opponentIsMonarch exists), so the granted triggered ability's if/otherwise branch cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Ring of Thune
lines: At the beginning of your upkeep, put a +1/+1 counter on equipped creature if it's white.
cards.backTranslation: At the beginning of your upkeep, if the equipped creature is white, put a +1/+1 counter on the equipped creature.

cards.name: Blessing of Leeches
lines: {0}: Regenerate enchanted creature.
cards.backTranslation: {0}: Regenerate enchanted creature. Activate at any time.

cards.name: Aspiring Champion
lines: Ruinous Ascension — When this creature deals combat damage to a player, sacrifice it. If you do, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card. Put that card onto the battlefield, then shuffle the rest into your library. If that creature is a Demon, it deals damage equal to its power to each opponent.
