cards.inexpressibleReason: Reveal until a creature card, put it onto the battlefield, shuffle the rest into the library, and deal damage if it is a Demon has no op in the schema.

cards.name: Possession Engine
lines: When this Vehicle enters, gain control of target creature an opponent controls for as long as you control this Vehicle. That creature can't attack or block for as long as you control this Vehicle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The gain-control duration "for as long as you control this Vehicle" ends on a change of control of the Vehicle, but the schema's gainControlTarget durations only offer whileSourceOnBattlefield (ends when the source leaves the battlefield), permanent, or untilEndOfTurn, and the "can't attack or block" restriction has no duration tied to control of the source.

cards.name: Nightblade Brigade
lines: Mobilize 1
cards.inexpressibleReason: Mobilize needs a tapped-and-attacking 1/1 Warrior token sacrificed at the beginning of the next end step, and createTokenAttacking has no end-step sacrifice option.

cards.name: Hoarder's Greed
lines: You lose 2 life and draw two cards, then clash with an opponent. If you win, repeat this process.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no clash effect (reveal top cards, compare mana values, repeat on win), so the clash and its repeat cannot be stated.

cards.name: Cruel Reality
lines: At the beginning of enchanted player's upkeep, that player sacrifices a creature or planeswalker of their choice. If the player can't, they lose 5 life.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect makes the event player sacrifice a creature or planeswalker of their choice and otherwise lose 5 life; sacrificeNonlandOrDiscardOrLoseLife offers discard instead, and sacrificeTargetPlayerCreature covers only creatures with no life-loss fallback.

cards.name: Yorvo, Lord of Garenbrig
lines: Whenever another green creature you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on ~. Then if that creature's power is greater than ~'s power, put another +1/+1 counter on ~.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever another green creature you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. Then if that creature's power is greater than or equal to this creature's power plus 1, put a second +1/+1 counter on this creature.

cards.name: Reenact the Crime
lines: Exile target nonland card in a graveyard that was put there from anywhere this turn. Copy it. You may cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No selector matches a card that was put into a graveyard from anywhere this turn.

cards.name: Hostile Desert
lines: {2}, Exile a land card from your graveyard: ~ becomes a 3/4 Elemental creature until end of turn. It's still a land.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The cost 'exile a land card from your graveyard' has no schema form: exileOtherCardsFromGraveyard takes only a count and no card-type filter.

cards.name: Isildur's Fateful Strike
lines: Destroy target creature. If its controller has more than four cards in hand, they exile cards from their hand equal to the difference.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The number of cards exiled from the controller's hand is the hand size minus four, and no Value expresses that difference.

cards.name: Kemba, Kha Regent
lines: At the beginning of your upkeep, create a 2/2 white Cat creature token for each Equipment attached to ~.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No selector or Value counts the Equipment attached to this creature (attachedToSource names the permanent it is attached to, and aurasAttachedToSource covers only Auras).

cards.name: Boreas Charger
lines: When this creature leaves the battlefield, choose an opponent who controls more lands than you. Search your library for a number of Plains cards equal to the difference, reveal those cards, put one of them onto the battlefield tapped and the rest into your hand, then shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No Value gives the difference between an opponent's land count and yours, so the number of Plains cards to search for cannot be stated.

cards.name: Kataki, War's Wage
lines: All artifacts have "At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice this artifact unless you pay {1}."
cards.backTranslation: All artifacts have "At the beginning of upkeep of the player who controls this Spirit, unless the artifact's controller pays {1}, sacrifice this artifact."
differences: Text A's granted upkeep trigger is at the beginning of your upkeep (the artifact's controller); Text B's trigger is at the upkeep of the player who controls the Spirit, which differs when another player controls the artifact.

cards.name: Hissing Miasma
lines: Whenever a creature attacks you, its controller loses 1 life.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The attacks trigger with eventObjectDefendingPlayerIsYou also fires when a creature attacks your planeswalker, and no condition limits the trigger to attacks on you alone.

cards.name: Roughshod Duo
lines: Whenever you expend 4, target creature you control gets +1/+1 and gains trample until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no 'whenever you expend 4' trigger event in the schema.

cards.name: Yathan Tombguard
lines: Whenever a creature you control with a counter on it deals combat damage to a player, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever a creature you control with one or more counters on it deals combat damage to a player, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.

cards.name: Heiko Yamazaki, the General
lines: Whenever a Samurai or Warrior you control attacks alone, you may cast target artifact card from your graveyard this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect lets a player cast a targeted artifact card from their graveyard this turn; the schema has no graveyard-cast permission for a resolving or triggered ability.

cards.name: Yavimaya Steelcrusher
lines: Enlist
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no enlist keyword or enlist effect (tap a nonattacking creature on attack and add its power).

cards.name: The Grim Captain's Locker
lines: {T}: Until end of turn, each creature card in your graveyard gains "Escape—{3}{B}, Exile four other cards from your graveyard."
cards.inexpressibleReason: No op grants an escape ability to every creature card in your graveyard until end of turn; grantAbilityUntilEot takes a single target.

cards.name: Beorn the Fierce
lines: At the beginning of combat on your turn, put a trample counter on up to one target creature you control. It becomes a Bear in addition to its other types. Then if you control three or more Bears, draw two cards.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No op makes a chosen creature a Bear in addition to its other types for the rest of the game; layer-4 addSubtypes applies only through a selector, and becomeCreatureUntilEot is until end of turn only.

cards.name: Ominous Harvest
lines: Gravestorm
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no gravestorm keyword or copy-per-permanent-put-into-graveyard-this-turn trigger.

cards.name: Aminatou, Veil Piercer
lines: Each enchantment card in your hand has miracle. Its miracle cost is equal to its mana cost reduced by {4}.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no miracle permission or miracle cost for enchantment cards in hand; grantForetell covers only foretell.

cards.name: Haze Frog
lines: When this creature enters, prevent all combat damage that other creatures would deal this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: 'Prevent all combat damage that other creatures would deal this turn' excludes Haze Frog itself, but preventCombatDamageAll covers every creature and the schema has no op that prevents combat damage from all creatures except the source.

cards.name: Corrupt
lines: ~ deals damage to any target equal to the number of Swamps you control. You gain life equal to the damage dealt this way.
cards.inexpressibleReason: 'Gain life equal to the damage dealt this way' needs the damage actually dealt by an earlier effect of the same spell (it changes under prevention or damage doubling); the schema has no such value, and damageDealt is trigger-only.

cards.name: Overabundance
lines: Whenever a player taps a land for mana, that player adds one mana of any type that land produced, and this enchantment deals 1 damage to the player.
cards.backTranslation:
Whenever a Land becomes tapped for mana, this enchantment deals 1 damage to the player associated with that event.
Each Land has a mana activation rider: the mana it adds is one of the types it could produce.
differences: Text A makes the tapping player add one additional mana of a type the land produced; Text B only restricts the type of each land's own mana and adds no extra mana.

cards.name: Training Regimen
lines: Creatures you control with +1/+1 counters on them have trample.
cards.backTranslation: Creatures you control with +1/+1 counters on them have trample.

cards.name: Mirri the Cursed
lines: Whenever ~ deals combat damage to a creature, put a +1/+1 counter on ~.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no trigger for a creature's combat damage dealt to another creature; combat-damage triggers only cover damage to a player or to an opponent.

cards.name: The Black Breath
lines: Creatures your opponents control get -1/-1 until end of turn. The Ring tempts you.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no effect for 'The Ring tempts you'.

cards.name: Evolutionary Escalation
lines: At the beginning of your upkeep, put three +1/+1 counters on target creature you control and three +1/+1 counters on target creature an opponent controls.
cards.backTranslation: At the beginning of your upkeep, put three +1/+1 counters on target creature you control and three +1/+1 counters on target creature an opponent controls.

cards.name: Secret Salvage
lines: Exile target nonland card from your graveyard. Search your library for any number of cards with the same name as that card, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No selector matches the name of the exiled target card, so 'cards with the same name as that card' cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Smite the Deathless
lines: ~ deals 3 damage to target creature. That creature loses indestructible until end of turn. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema cannot remove indestructible from one targeted creature for the turn, nor make that creature exiled instead of dying for the rest of the turn.

cards.name: Darkblast
lines: Dredge 3
cards.inexpressibleReason: Dredge 3 (mill three cards instead of drawing, then return this card from the graveyard) has no keyword or draw-replacement form in the schema.

cards.name: Three Dreams
lines: Search your library for up to three Aura cards with different names, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
cards.backTranslation: Search your library for three Aura enchantment cards with different names, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
differences: Text A searches for up to three Aura cards (zero to three allowed); Text B requires exactly three Aura enchantment cards.

cards.name: Holy Avenger
lines: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage, you may put an Aura card from your hand onto the battlefield attached to it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The trigger needs any combat damage dealt by the equipped creature, but dealsCombatDamageToPlayer covers only damage to players.

cards.name: Avalanche of Sector 7
lines: Whenever an opponent activates an ability of an artifact they control, ~ deals 1 damage to that player.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The activatesAbility trigger can only watch abilities activated by the card's controller (player 'you'), with no way to watch an opponent's activations of abilities of artifacts they control.

cards.name: Calamity's Wake
lines: Exile all graveyards. Players can't cast noncreature spells this turn. Exile ~.
cards.inexpressibleReason: prohibitSpellsThisTurn has no filter, so "Players can't cast noncreature spells this turn" cannot be stated exactly (it would also bar creature spells).

cards.name: Heroes in a Half Shell
lines: Whenever one or more Mutants, Ninjas, and/or Turtles you control deal combat damage to a player, put a +1/+1 counter on each of those creatures and draw a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect puts a +1/+1 counter on each creature in the group that dealt combat damage to the player (the trigger's aggregate group); putCountersEach takes only a static selector, which would also hit attackers that were blocked or attacked a planeswalker.

cards.name: Infested Fleshcutter
lines: Whenever equipped creature attacks, create a 1/1 colorless Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token with toxic 1 and "~ can't block."
cards.inexpressibleReason: The Phyrexian Mite token needs toxic 1, but TokenSpec has no toxic field, so the token's toxic keyword cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Keen-Eyed Curator
lines: As long as there are four or more card types among cards exiled with this creature, it gets +4/+4 and has trample.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No Value counts card types among cards exiled with this creature, since countCardsInZone reads only graveyard, hand or library.

cards.name: Taunting Sliver
lines: Sliver creatures you control have "When this creature enters, goad target creature an opponent controls."
cards.backTranslation: Each Sliver creature you control has "When this creature enters, goad target creature an opponent controls."

cards.name: Shallow Grave
lines: Return the top creature card of your graveyard to the battlefield. That creature gains haste until end of turn. Exile it at the beginning of the next end step.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect returns the top creature card of your graveyard to the battlefield: the untargeted return op lets the player choose the card, and no op selects by graveyard position.

cards.name: Shantotto, Tactician Magician
lines: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, ~ gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the amount of mana spent to cast that spell. If X is 4 or more, draw a card.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this creature gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the amount of mana spent to cast that spell. If at least four mana was spent to cast that spell, draw a card.

cards.name: Bar the Gate
lines: Counter target creature or planeswalker spell. Venture into the dungeon.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no venture-into-the-dungeon effect, so the line 'Venture into the dungeon' cannot be modeled.

cards.name: Barret Wallace
lines: Whenever ~ attacks, it deals damage equal to the number of equipped creatures you control to defending player.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever this creature attacks, this ability deals damage to the defending player equal to the number of creatures you control that are equipped.

cards.name: Irresistible Prey
lines: Target creature must be blocked this turn if able.
cards.inexpressibleReason: 'Target creature must be blocked this turn if able' (the target's attackers are forced to be blocked) has no schema form; setMustBlockThisTurn makes the target block, which is the opposite requirement.

cards.name: Breakthrough
lines: Draw four cards, then choose X cards in your hand and discard the rest.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No discard op discards the controller's hand minus a chosen X (the discard count is a fixed number or random), so 'choose X cards in your hand and discard the rest' cannot be stated.

cards.name: Depart the Realm
lines: Foretell {U}
cards.inexpressibleReason: Foretell {U} on this card itself (the card's own foretell keyword and its foretell cost) has no schema form; grantForetell only gives other hand cards foretell.

cards.name: Throatseeker
lines: Unblocked attacking Ninjas you control have lifelink.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema's selectors can match attacking creatures (combatRole) but cannot match an unblocked attacker, so "unblocked attacking Ninjas you control" cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Acquired Mutation
lines: Whenever enchanted creature attacks, defending player gets two rad counters.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Rad counters on a player have no counter op in the schema; giveTargetPoisonCounters covers poison counters only.

cards.name: Daring Piracy
lines: At the beginning of combat on your turn, create a 1/1 red Pirate creature token with menace and haste. Exile it at the beginning of the next end step.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect exiles a created token at the beginning of the next end step (the delayed sacrifice op exists, but no delayed exile of a token created by this ability).

cards.name: Dreadship Reef
lines: {1}, Remove X storage counters from this land: Add X mana in any combination of {U} and/or {B}.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Removing X storage counters to add X mana of U and/or B needs an announced activation X tied to the counter removal and an any-combination amount, which no mana ability or cost form expresses (removeCounters takes a fixed or state-derived count only).

cards.name: Fireglass Mentor
lines: At the beginning of your second main phase, if an opponent lost life this turn, exile the top two cards of your library. Choose one of them. Until end of turn, you may play that card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema can exile the top two cards and allow playing them, but has no way to have the controller choose one of two exiled cards and allow play of only that chosen card.

cards.name: Animal Friend
lines: Enchanted creature has "Whenever this creature attacks, create a 1/1 green Squirrel creature token. Put a +1/+1 counter on that token for each Aura and Equipment attached to this creature other than ~."
cards.inexpressibleReason: The granted attack trigger must put a number of +1/+1 counters equal to the Auras and Equipment attached to the creature (other than Animal Friend) on the token it just created, and the schema has no reference to a created token for counter placement and no count of attached Equipment.

cards.name: Angelic Exaltation
lines: Whenever a creature you control attacks alone, it gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of creatures you control.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever a creature you control attacks alone, that creature gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of creatures you control.

cards.name: Jor Kadeen, First Goldwarden
lines: Whenever ~ attacks, it gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of equipped creatures you control. Then if ~'s power is 4 or greater, draw a card.
cards.backTranslation:
Whenever this creature attacks, it gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of creatures you control that are equipped.
If this creature's power is 4 or greater, draw a card.

cards.name: Raven Eagle
lines: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, exile up to one target card from a graveyard. If a creature card is exiled this way, create a Clue token.
validatorIssues: override.def.triggers[0].effects[0].targetSlot: cardInGraveyard is incompatible with effect domains permanent
override.def.triggers[0].effects[1].checkTarget: effect target 0 does not reference an ordinary target slot
override.def.triggers[0].effects[1].condition: event object information requires an owning permanent event scope
override.def.triggers[1].effects[0].targetSlot: cardInGraveyard is incompatible with effect domains permanent
override.def.triggers[1].effects[1].checkTarget: effect target 0 does not reference an ordinary target slot
override.def.triggers[1].effects[1].condition: event object information requires an owning permanent event scope
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema cannot say "if a creature card is exiled this way" for a targeted graveyard card (exileEachChosen is permanent-domain and conditions cannot read a cardInGraveyard target), and exileGraveyardCardWithSource draws a card rather than creating a Clue.

cards.name: Mesmerizing Dose
lines: Enchanted creature doesn't untap during its controller's untap step.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No static effect or rule static stops an enchanted creature from untapping during its controller's untap step (doesntUntapDuringUntapStep applies only to the card itself).

cards.name: Portable Hole
lines: When this artifact enters, exile target nonland permanent an opponent controls with mana value 2 or less until this artifact leaves the battlefield.
cards.backTranslation: When this enters, exile target nonland permanent an opponent controls with mana value 2 or less until this leaves the battlefield.

cards.name: Bontu the Glorified
lines: ~ can't attack or block unless a creature died under your control this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no condition for whether a creature died under your control this turn, so the attack and block restriction cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Dwarven Scorcher
lines: Sacrifice this creature: ~ deals 1 damage to target creature unless that creature's controller has this creature deal 2 damage to them.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The 'unless that creature's controller has this creature deal 2 damage to them' choice belongs to the target's controller and is not an option the schema can offer (unlessPays only takes mana, and dealDamageUnlessSacrifice is a sacrifice).

cards.name: Junktown
lines: {4}{R}, {T}, Sacrifice this land: Create three Junk tokens.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The Junk token's ability (sorcery speed, exile the top card, you may play that card this turn, lands included) has no confirmed exact form: exileTopNPlayableUntilEot is documented for casting spells, and castOnly is the only play restriction shown.

cards.name: Smoke Spirits' Aid
lines: For each of up to X target creatures, create a red Aura enchantment token named Smoke Blessing attached to that creature. Those tokens have enchant creature and "When enchanted creature dies, it deals 1 damage to its controller and you create a Treasure token."
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect creates one Aura token attached to each of up to X chosen targets (createAttachedToken takes a single target), and the token's dies trigger with its own 1-damage-and-Treasure rider has no shape for a per-target variable count.

cards.name: Inspired Ultimatum
lines: Target player gains 5 life, ~ deals 5 damage to any target, then you draw five cards.
cards.backTranslation:
Target player gains 5 life.
This spell deals 5 damage to any target.
You draw five cards.

cards.name: Glowspore Shaman
lines: When this creature enters, mill three cards. You may put a land card from your graveyard on top of your library.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The optional put-a-land-from-your-graveyard-on-top step must choose a card after the mill resolves, but a targeted slot is fixed at announcement before the mill, and no op mills then chooses a land to put on top of the library.

cards.name: Acquire
lines: Search target opponent's library for an artifact card and put that card onto the battlefield under your control. Then that player shuffles.
cards.inexpressibleReason: searchLibrary only searches the controller's own library, and no op searches a target opponent's library and puts the found card onto the battlefield under the controller's control.

cards.name: Lightning, Security Sergeant
lines: Whenever ~ deals combat damage to a player, exile the top card of your library. You may play that card for as long as you control ~.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The exiled card's play permission lasts as long as you control Lightning, but the exile-and-play effects only grant permission until end of turn, and no schema op ties the permission to controlling the source.

cards.name: Prompto Argentum
lines: Selfie Shot — Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, if at least four mana was spent to cast it, create a Treasure token.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever you cast a spell that isn't a creature spell, if at least four mana was spent to cast it, create a token. It is a Treasure artifact token with "{T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add one mana of any color."

cards.name: Cemetery Recruitment
lines: Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand. If it's a Zombie card, draw a card.
validatorIssues: override.def.spellAbility.effects[0].condition: event object information requires an owning permanent event scope
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no way to branch on whether a targeted graveyard card is a Zombie card (conditions cannot read a cardInGraveyard target), and no returned-card-conditional draw op exists.

cards.name: Night Soil
lines: {1}, Exile two creature cards from a single graveyard: Create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The cost 'exile two creature cards from a single graveyard' (any graveyard, creature cards only) has no schema form; exileOtherCardsFromGraveyard covers only the controller's graveyard with no type filter.

cards.name: Grappling Hook
lines: Whenever equipped creature attacks, you may have target creature block it this turn if able.
cards.inexpressibleReason: setMustBlockThisTurn names only the blocker, with no way to say it must block the equipped creature that attacked, so 'target creature block it this turn if able' cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Saving Grace
lines: When this Aura enters, all damage that would be dealt this turn to you and permanents you control is dealt to enchanted creature instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no effect that redirects damage dealt to you and your permanents to the enchanted creature; only prevention shields (createDamageShield) and reflect-to-controller exist.

cards.name: Confirm Suspicions
lines: Investigate three times.
cards.backTranslation:
Counter target spell.
Create three colorless Clue artifact tokens with the subtype Clue. Each has "{2}, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card."

cards.name: Giott, King of the Dwarves
lines: Whenever ~ or another Dwarf you control enters and whenever an Equipment you control enters, you may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever a Dwarf you control or an Equipment you control enters, you may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.

cards.name: Azog, Moria's Ruin
lines: When ~ enters, destroy up to one other target creature. Its controller amasses Goblins X, where X is that creature's power. If you controlled that creature, draw a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The amass goes to the controller of the destroyed creature, but the amass effect has no player field and always amasses for the ability's controller.

cards.name: Isolated Watchtower
lines: {2}, {T}: Scry 1, then you may reveal the top card of your library. If a basic land card is revealed this way, put it onto the battlefield tapped. Activate only if an opponent controls at least two more lands than you.
cards.inexpressibleReason: 'Activate only if an opponent controls at least two more lands than you' needs a margin-of-two comparison, but opponentControlsMore only tests for more lands.

cards.name: Skyline Cascade
lines: When this land enters, target creature an opponent controls doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect makes a target creature an opponent controls skip its controller's next untap step (only the source-level doesntUntapDuringUntapStep flag exists, and no targeted untap-skip op).

cards.name: Red Hulk
lines: Whenever ~ is dealt damage, put a +1/+1 counter on him. When you do, he deals damage equal to the number of +1/+1 counters on him to any other target.
cards.backTranslation:
Whenever this creature is dealt damage, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
When you do, this creature deals damage equal to the number of +1/+1 counters on this creature to target creature, player, planeswalker, or battle.
differences: Text A's damage goes to any other target, so the creature cannot target itself; Text B's target is any creature, player, planeswalker, or battle with no 'other' restriction, so it can target itself.

cards.name: Portent of Calamity
lines: Reveal the top X cards of your library. For each card type, you may exile a card of that type from among them. Put the rest into your graveyard. You may cast a spell from among the exiled cards without paying its mana cost if you exiled four or more cards this way. Then put the rest of the exiled cards into your hand.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The per-card-type optional exile choice and the 'cast a spell if you exiled four or more cards this way' gate have no op.

cards.name: Ezzaroot Channeler
lines: Creature spells you cast cost {X} less to cast, where X is the amount of life you gained this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No Value reads the amount of life you gained this turn, so 'creature spells you cast cost {X} less, where X is the life you gained this turn' cannot be stated.

cards.name: Mogg Assassin
lines: {T}: You choose target creature an opponent controls, and that opponent chooses target creature. Flip a coin. If you win the flip, destroy the creature you chose. If you lose the flip, destroy the creature your opponent chose.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The opponent choosing a target creature is not expressible, since target slots are chosen only by the controller, and the coin flip that destroys one of two separately chosen creatures has no schema form.

cards.name: Bond of Insight
lines: Each player mills four cards. Return up to two instant and/or sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand. Exile ~.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Each player mills four and then the controller returns up to two instant or sorcery cards from the graveyard, but millAndReturnSpells is fixed at six and controller-only, and no each-player mill-then-return op exists.

cards.name: Silhana Ledgewalker
lines: ~ can't be blocked except by creatures with flying.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No rule static says this creature can't be blocked except by creatures with flying: setCantBeBlocked removes all blocking and cantBlockCreatures only compares power.

cards.name: Enchanter's Bane
lines: At the beginning of your end step, target enchantment deals damage equal to its mana value to its controller unless that player sacrifices it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: dealDamageUnlessSacrifice lets the target choose to sacrifice a creature, but the line needs the enchantment's controller to choose to sacrifice that targeted enchantment instead of taking damage equal to its mana value.

cards.name: Tolarian Kraken
lines: Whenever you draw a card, you may pay {1}. When you do, you may tap or untap target creature.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever you draw a card, you may pay {1}. If you do, you may choose target creature. Choose one: tap that creature; or untap that creature.
differences: Text A's tap-or-untap is optional ('you may tap or untap'), so the player can choose neither; Text B makes the tap/untap mode mandatory once a target is chosen ('Choose one: tap...; or untap...') with no 'you may' on the effect.

Text B says 'you may choose target creature' as a separate optional step after paying; Text A's target is chosen by the reflexive trigger with the effect itself optional, so the optional-ness sits in a different place.

cards.name: Deepmuck Desperado
lines: Whenever you commit a crime, each opponent mills three cards. This ability triggers only once each turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no trigger event for 'you commit a crime' (targeting an opponent, anything they control, or cards in their graveyards).

cards.name: Giant Ox
lines: ~ crews Vehicles using its toughness rather than its power.
cards.inexpressibleReason: crewVehicle takes only a minimum power and has no way to crew using toughness instead of power.

cards.name: Empress Galina
lines: {U}{U}, {T}: Gain control of target legendary permanent.
cards.backTranslation: {U}{U}, {T}: Gain control of target legendary permanent. This effect lasts indefinitely. Activate at any time.
